svg.title: Fig. 173(b) — Directional curves: y = e⁻ˣ cos x between its damping envelopes
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 173(b), page 190. Section: sketching.

g.data-text: Draw the axes and the two horizontal lines y = ±1 (dashed): cos x oscillates between them.
Draw the factor cos x lightly: maxima at 0 and 2π, minimum at π, zeros at π/2, 3π/2, 5π/2.
Draw the damping factor and its mirror image, y = ±e^(−x/2) (thin): they start at ±1 on the y-axis and fall towards the axis.
Draw the product: it crosses the axis where cos x does (π/2, 3π/2, 5π/2) and touches the envelope where cos x = ±1 (at 0, π, 2π); each wave is smaller than the one before.
